footprints.get.description: Return the measured placement footprint for one object type, with the render it was measured from.

footprints.list.description: Page the measured placement footprints, optionally filtered by name, source, or size.

footprints.set.description: Record a hand-corrected footprint for one object type. Persisted separately so a rebuild of the measurements cannot erase it.

map.create.description: Create a map with default water/light and no random starting waypoints.

map.export_project.description: Export current map, companions and complete authoring history into a new directory.

map.export_package.description: Export current map and companion files without internal authoring history.

map.save.description: Save the current map and protection metadata.

map.save_as.description: Export only the map file; does not change this session's save target.

map.info.description: Query dimensions, revision and authoring state.

history.undo.description: Restore previous map and authoring state.

history.redo.description: Restore next map and authoring state.

system.capabilities.description: Discover current capabilities and configured providers.

system.schema.description: Read command argument schemas; omit command for all.

map.inspect_file.description: Inspect an existing file through an immutable copy without creating a session in its directory. Returns observed players, teams, starts and paged regular objects; does not certify authenticity or gameplay.

terrain.set_height.description: Set rectangle height; passability is not automatically rebuilt.

terrain.sculpt.description: Set or raise rectangle/circle height with smooth edge falloff.

terrain.smooth.description: Smooth selected heights using previous-iteration neighbors.

terrain.ramp.description: Create a quantized polyline ramp. Validate external connections separately.

terrain.analyze.description: Analyze current or prepared terrain and optional explicit object footprints with square clearance; return components and optional shortest four-neighbor routes. Unknown object footprints reject. Not game pathfinding.

terrain.rebuild_passability.description: Replace ordinary passability flags across the map; preserve special flags. Supports undo.

textures.list.description: Search texture names declared by the library; mod availability is unverified.

art.profile.description: Measure the open map's art profile: material variety and shares, blend share, prop density, clumping, and category mix. Reports, does not judge.

review.render_set.description: Render a review set for the current revision: a north-up overview plus four local crops at fixed fractions, composed into one contact sheet, together with the rubric verdict against the thresholds measured from shipped maps.

art.rules.description: Report art-direction statistics measured from shipped maps: material counts and shares, blend share, prop density, clumping, category mix, and the rules derived from them.

assets.album.description: Return the agent-rendered appearance image for an object the editor ships no screenshot for.

assets.catalog_info.description: Report the frozen asset catalogue: counts, texture surfaces and themes, object categories, screenshot coverage, sources and caveats.

assets.search.description: Search textures and objects with derived semantics: surface, theme, category, transition-only, or only objects missing an editor screenshot.

assets.objects.description: Search editor-declared object names and category labels with source hash.

texture.paint_by_height.description: Paint each cell by the elevation band it falls in, optionally varying the material per coarse block within a band. Boundaries follow the terrain rather than the brush shape.

texture.paint.description: Paint texture and optionally blend a one-cell halo.

waypoints.place.description: Place a waypoint; z defaults to zero.

starts.place.description: Place one Player_N_Start waypoint (slot 1–6). Rejects duplicate slots, coincident starts and positions outside playable area. Does not validate spawn clearance or initialize gameplay.

starts.list.description: List player-start waypoints, handles, invalid names and duplicate slots.

waypoints.move.description: Move a waypoint by stable handle; omitted z resets to zero.

waypoints.delete.description: Delete one exact object instance by stable handle.

objects.delete.description: Delete one exact object instance by stable handle.

objects.query.description: List regular objects and stable handles; excludes roads and waypoints.

objects.place.description: Place a regular object; optional ownerTeam must exist with a valid player. Typed settings preserve unspecified defaults. Does not validate footprint or gameplay.

objects.configure.description: Update name, existing ownerTeam or typed settings without moving the object. Does not certify gameplay behavior.

objects.move.description: Move a regular object; omitted z and angle preserve current values.

objects.analyze_space.description: Check caller-supplied rotated rectangles, including optional access boxes, for overlap and playable bounds. Unknown types make coverage incomplete. Not engine collision or gameplay validation.

map.validate.description: Validate current or prepared map against explicit static rules: expected starts, bounds, owners, resource counts, resource access distance fairness, build areas, footprints and connectivity. Resource access uses a named nonblocking footprint box and compares ranked nearest distances by player. Returns a report, not gameplay certification.

objects.scatter.description: Deterministic region scatter with center spacing, exclusions and terrain filtering. Optional footprints require all existing and new types; reject footprint overlap, boundary and blocked terrain/exclusion intersections. Rejects partial placement.

clusters.description: Grove count. Zero keeps evenly spaced placement and reports the clumping index it produces; shipped maps cluster.

protections.add.description: Protect selected layers; removal and edits cannot bypass protection in the same batch.

protections.remove.description: Remove protection by id; use a separate transaction before changing that region.

preview.start.description: Queue real WorldBuilder overview from current state or a prepared candidate; poll jobs.status.

diagnostics.render.description: Render analytical height, base texture, object-center, connectivity or protection layers with legend and revision. Optional passability routes draw shortest paths and endpoint markers, with route status and coordinates in metadata; not game appearance.

preview.inspect.description: Return a verified overview or pixel crop with coordinate mapping; MCP also returns inline PNG image content.

jobs.status.description: Query or cancel a render job created by this host.

jobs.cancel.description: Query or cancel a render job created by this host.

batch.execute.description: Execute up to 100 mutation commands as one transaction and revision; all-or-nothing.

edits.prepare.description: Run edits on isolated state, normalize and check protections; retain candidate for 30 minutes in this session. Does not commit. Not a semantic DesignSpec compiler.

edits.apply.description: Commit the exact prepared candidate with source revision, content and catalog checks. Does not rerun generation. Cannot be nested in a batch.

edits.discard.description: Release a prepared candidate from this session.

design.query.description: Read committed entity specifications, owned object handles and design hash. Original/generated height cells are optional.

design.prepare.description: Prepare platform, ramp, texture, object, scatter or derived rotate180 entities. Texture owns its region and auto-blend halo; rotate180 reflects selected cells and recomputes target blends without rotating bitmap pixels. Ramp heights can reference platform targets via startHeightFrom/endHeightFrom. References imply dependencies; dependsOn enables layering. Rejects manual conflicts and cycles. No gameplay route compiler yet.

design.apply.description: Commit a prepared design candidate and entity bindings in one history step. Uses design candidates only.

terrain.detect_cliffs.description: Detect directed dual-grid height discontinuity lines, high ground on the left. Coordinates are playableGrid; does not infer wide steep slopes or engine cliff flags.

objects.place_cliffs.description: Place cliff decoration along detected seams with deterministic variation. Style length/depth are seam-aligned cells, required unless measured. Positive normal offset points uphill; origin offsets correct model pivots independently of coverage. Object Z is terrain-relative: baseHeight terrain uses zOffset directly; low/high convert absolute target to an offset using bilinear terrain sampling. Skips blocked/bent spans and returns counts. Supports prepared edits and undo; visual model fit needs calibration.
